find.label: Crownsplitter
find.effect: Deal +2 melee damage to stunned or slowed foes.
find.tradeoff: Slower than a sword. Control must be active.

find.label: Hearthglass
find.effect: Recover 2 HP when a direct attack slays a natural hostile foe.
find.tradeoff: Only 1 base guard. Summons, allies and hazards give no healing.

find.label: Frostmantle
find.effect: Take 2 less gas and poison damage, with at least 1 damage per harmful tick.
find.tradeoff: Slower movement. Take +1 damage from melee blows.
